scope: Ordinary Google Drive-backed Resource Library source/provider attribution only
evidence_policy: Use explicit provider branding inside reviewed files.
Use reviewed Resource Library manifest evidence where it matches a coherent collection.
Use highly specific collection folder patterns only after cross-subject/content review.
Use explicit official-IB and school-managed filename evidence.
Do not infer a provider from visual style alone.
Do not label the legacy Question Bank archive as Revision Town without independent evidence.
Leave mixed textbooks, student work, IA/EE samples and ambiguous learning resources under review rather than guess.

remaining_under_review.reason: Residual items are mixed or do not contain enough reviewed acquisition/provider evidence for a safe automatic assignment.

ib_official: Past Papers collections use session/year/level/paper/markscheme structures across subjects.
Reviewed subject guides explicitly identify the International Baccalaureate Organization as publisher.
Specimen Papers, Guides and Syllabus, Formula & Data Booklets and Grade Boundaries use verified official patterns.
save_my_exams: Reviewed Notes PDFs across Biology, Business, Mathematics and Psychology contain Save My Exams branding/copyright.
revisiondojo: Reviewed Cheatsheets across Economics, Biology, Business, English and Physics explicitly reference revisiondojo.com.
The reviewed Math AI predicted/mock paper collection matches RevisionDojo material.
christos_nikolaidis: Reviewed Math AA/AI Study Materials explicitly credit Christos Nikolaidis.
The Resource Library manifest contains a Christos Nikolaidis Maths entry.
Reviewed Math AA mock materials carry Christos Nikolaidis/CN attribution.
brilliant_learning: Physics Study Materials titles match the reviewed Brilliant Learning IB DP Physics practice-topic catalogue.
school: Assignments are limited to explicit DIA subject briefs, course/programme/curriculum/subject outlines, school assessment/planning documents and similarly explicit filenames.
padlet: Only the five current Library items whose filenames explicitly state Padlet provenance were assigned to Padlet; no DIA Padlet identity was inferred without matching evidence.
